title: Records with George Lewis and Bunk Johnson
summary: Zardis made records only with George Lewis and Bunk, at Canal Street and the Gypsy Tea Room.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I was going to ask about recordings. In the old days they didn't make many records here I guess.
No they didn't make any records. You made those at George Lewis and some with Bunk. Yeah, yeah.
Did you ever make any others?
No, I didn't make any others. No, I did not. Because last time we made those records was on Canal Street, weren't they?
Yeah, the first ones were in Canal Street. And the ones we made was over at the Gypsy Tea Room. Gypsy Tea Room, remember?
Gypsy Tea Room, that's right. That's right. That's correct. That's right. That's correct. But you never get any of those records, I would have changed the name on them records, the label.
